verdict.rationale: There are only indirect signs of customization. The framework-removal docs say controls are kept when they contain "custom content," which implies controls can be customized. The Fieldwork page invites you to "describe your control" and have AI agents collect and validate evidence for it. Nothing explicitly documents creating custom frameworks, or custom controls with your own tests and evidence requirements. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom framework creation, custom control creation, user-defined automated tests, configurable evidence requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
